label: PF Backlog 192
title: Backend: auto-create a functional spec for backlog items that are changes/new (not planned features)
body:
## Problem / why When a backlog item is a CHANGE from the original design or a NEW item that is NOT part of the planned features (no feature_id / not in design+architect output), it has no functional spec - so its design is unclear. Planned features get `artifacts/1 - Design/features/F-x-functional.md`; ad-hoc changes do not. ## Goal & value For every backlog item that is a change/new (not a planned feature), create a per-item FUNCTIONAL SPEC so the item is clear and design-authoritative, referenced by the item. ## In scope - Detect items that are changes/new (no feature_id, or flagged as change vs original design). - Generate a functional spec from the item's rich context (template: problem/scope/behaviour/ acceptance/edge cases/API), sourced from the item + its linked artifacts/items. - Store at `products/

/artifacts/1 - Design/changes/-functional.md` (owner = generator), append-only; link it back on the item (links.spec). - Register the store; wire into the item lifecycle (on create/accept) so it is not a manual step. ## Acceptance criteria (testable) - A change/new item gets a functional spec file + `links.spec` set; planned-feature items do not. - Re-run is idempotent (no duplicate spec; spec updated only when the item body changes). ## Out of scope - Full design/review of the spec (human/agent review is separate). ## Open questions - Trigger point: on create, on triage/accept, or a batch job? - Should the generator use an LLM call or a template filled from the item context? ## Verification / test plan - Create a change item -> spec file exists + linked; planned feature item -> unchanged; gate green.

dashboard_impact.reason: Backend capability/knowledge + spec generation; consumed via API, no UI change.

_note:
core/change_spec.py: changes/-functional.md generator for change/new items (no feature_id + type feature/change/tech-debt). Wired into core/intake.py on item creation; CLI `python -m core.change_spec --project

`. Idempotent via src-body-sha256; links back links.spec; planned-feature items skipped. Store registered. VERIFIED: change item -> spec + links.spec; re-run changed=False; body change -> refresh; planned feature -> None. compileall=0, wired_audit=0.
